name: scenelyr
description: Import diagram images locally, inspect semantic objects, edit relationships, and export editable visuals.

interface.shortDescription: Turn diagram images into editable semantic scenes.
interface.longDescription: SceneLyr runs locally to detect diagram objects and connectors, read printed labels with optional on-device OCR, edit the semantic graph, and export JSON, SVG, HTML, and editable PowerPoint.
defaultPrompt: Import this diagram and list its objects and arrows.
Correct the labels and relationships in my saved scene.
Export this SceneLyr diagram as SVG and PowerPoint.
